  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. Predictive brake assist helps see to it that you stop.

Mercedes-Benz engineering, premium passenger comfort, and the versatility of a professionally customized interior come together in this 2019 Mercedes-Benz Metris Passenger Van, featuring a conversion by Explorer Van Company of Warsaw, Indiana. Combining the practicality of a midsize passenger van with the upscale character of a luxury conversion vehicle, this Metris offers a distinctive alternative to traditional SUVs and full-size passenger vans. Its clean European styling, signature Mercedes-Benz grille, large windows, and practical sliding side doors create a sophisticated yet functional exterior. The Explorer Van Company conversion further enhances its appeal, transforming an already versatile platform into a vehicle designed with passenger comfort and convenience in mind.

Inside, the Metris offers a spacious cabin with generous headroom, excellent visibility, and easy access to the passenger compartment. The Explorer Van Company conversion distinguishes this vehicle from a conventional factory-configured Metris, emphasizing a more personalized and upscale passenger experience. The van's generous interior dimensions provide an excellent foundation for comfortable seating and practical storage, while its large side windows create an open, inviting atmosphere. Whether transporting family members, accommodating guests, or enjoying extended road trips, the Metris offers the flexibility and comfort that make luxury passenger conversions so appealing.

Technology and convenience complement the Metris's practical design. Mercedes-Benz's driver-oriented dashboard provides straightforward access to essential vehicle functions, while air conditioning, power-operated convenience features, and an ergonomic driving position make daily operation comfortable and intuitive. The van's sliding side doors simplify passenger entry and exit, particularly in parking areas where conventional doors can be difficult to open fully.
